dauer.hinweis.text1: The country has confirmed you in office for the {nr}th time. Whoever rules this long becomes part of the landscape, and whoever wants to change it becomes your opponent.
dauer.hinweis.text2: With each further term, fatigue, ambition in the cabinet, distrust abroad and pressure from the street grow. Your age also becomes an issue.
dauer.log_warum: Whoever rules beyond the second term pays with fatigue, the rivals’ ambition, legitimacy, the street and relations with Europe.
enden.alter.text1: At {alter}, press and party ask how much longer the president can carry the office. Health becomes an issue.
enden.alter.text2: The ambitious in the cabinet are calculating: whoever gains ground now is ready when the time comes.
enden.alter.warum: With age the risk of a serious illness grows (game parameter); the ambitious ministers see their chance.
enden.amtsenthebung.abgeschrieben.text: The majority needed for the motion has collapsed; the procedure fizzles out.
enden.amtsenthebung.anklage.log: Indictment before the Constitutional Court ({gegen} votes).
enden.amtsenthebung.anklage.text1: With {gegen} votes, parliament indicts the president before the Constitutional Court.
enden.amtsenthebung.anklage.text2: The court will decide in about two months. How independent it is will decide the outcome.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.abwarten_ausg: You let the procedure run. It will be decided in parliament.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.abwarten_besc: No cost. The opposition continues the procedure as long as its majority holds.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.einschwoeren_: The group leaders commit their members to unity. For six months the ranks hold; the price is a little standing.
Costs {pk} capital and some legitimacy. For six months the number of defectors is halved.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.log: The opposition tables a motion to remove the president.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.text1: The opposition tables a motion to remove the president; {gegen} members of parliament would vote for it. An investigation would need 360 votes, an indictment before the Constitutional Court 400.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.text2: Your bloc holds {lager} seats. Whether it stays united depends on what the parliamentary groups experience in the coming weeks.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.warum: {gegen} members of parliament would vote against you; the first hurdle is 301.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.warum_kurz: Removal has three hurdles: 301 votes for the motion, 360 for an investigation, 400 for an indictment before the Constitutional Court. Defectors in your own bloc decide.
enden.amtsenthebung.antrag.zugestaendnis: Posts, pledges and a listening ear: the partners stand more firmly with you again. That lasts as long as the concessions work.
Costs {pk} capital. The partners in the bloc move closer (loyalty +6) and the defectors halve for a good four months.
enden.amtsenthebung.freispruch.text: The Constitutional Court rejects the indictment. The president stays in office, and the country remains divided.
enden.amtsenthebung.ohne_anklage.text: The investigation ends without an indictment: 400 votes were not reached. The office remains, and so does the shadow.
enden.amtsenthebung.untersuchung.text1: Parliament decides in a secret ballot to open the investigation: {gegen} votes.
enden.amtsenthebung.untersuchung.text2: While the investigation runs, the president cannot call new elections; the escape forward is blocked.
enden.amtsenthebung.verurteilt.text: After parliament’s indictment ({gegen} votes), the Constitutional Court convicts {name}. The office ends; a new election follows within 45 days.
enden.duell.nachfolger.desaster: A disaster on live television: {gegner} serves up the government’s weak points sentence by sentence, and {name} finds no way out.
enden.duell.nachfolger.gleich: Ninety minutes of a showpiece duel: both stay in their roles, nobody tips the scales. Viewers switch off content and vote as before.
enden.duell.nachfolger.hinten: {gegner} arrives better prepared than it looked and pushes {name} onto the defensive over the government’s record.
enden.duell.nachfolger.klar: {gegner} gets tangled in the figures; {name} stays calm and scores the point of the evening. The commentary is unanimous: a clear win for the bloc.
enden.duell.nachfolger.vorn: An evening without a knockout: {name} scores on the record, {gegner} on tone. A slight advantage for the bloc.
enden.krankheit.abgeben_ausgang: The president announces resignation for health reasons.
enden.krankheit.abgeben_beschr: The office ends at once, with dignity and a balance sheet.
enden.krankheit.genesen.text: The treatment is complete; the president resumes official duties at full strength.
enden.krankheit.leck.log: Rumours about the president’s health grow.
enden.krankheit.leck.text: The press reports that the president is seriously ill and the government is hiding it. Denials no longer help.
enden.krankheit.offen: Say it openly and have treatment
enden.krankheit.offen_ausgang: The president announces the diagnosis and has treatment. The country responds with sympathy and questions; treatment ends in three months.
enden.krankheit.offen_beschr: Costs {pk} capital and some legitimacy. The country learns of it; three months of treatment, after which the president is well again.
enden.krankheit.ruecktritt.text: {name} resigns for health reasons. The term ends; a new election follows within 45 days.
enden.krankheit.text1: In a routine check-up the doctors find something that needs treatment. Without treatment, collapses threaten; with it, the president is away for weeks.
enden.krankheit.text2: Whoever learns of it lets the country and the markets read how much longer this term will last.
enden.krankheit.tod.text: {name} dies after a serious illness. The country mourns; a new election follows within 45 days, until then the vice president runs the business of government.
enden.krankheit.verschweigen_ausgang: The diagnosis stays within the innermost circle. Every month carries the risk of a leak or a collapse.
enden.krankheit.verschweigen_beschr: No cost today. Rumours will come, and a collapse could end the office.
enden.krankheit.warum: Every head of state ages; an office with little sleep and heavy pressure speeds it up. Openness costs standing; silence costs more if it comes out.
enden.krankheit.zusammenbruch.text: {name} collapses at an appointment and is unable to carry on. The resignation is announced.
enden.putsch.geruecht.log: Rumours of a coup are going round.
enden.putsch.geruecht.text1: In Ankara, reports circulate about meetings of officers, phone lists and postponed exercises.
enden.putsch.geruecht.text2: Nothing is proven yet. But the officers’ trust in the country’s leadership has fallen so far that observers speak of a dangerous situation.
enden.putsch.geruecht.warum: The coup risk stands at {risiko} out of 100.
enden.putsch.gescheitert.chronik: A coup attempt under {general} fails; the general staff is replaced.
enden.putsch.gescheitert.fakt: A coup attempt under {general} has failed; the general staff was replaced.
enden.putsch.gescheitert.log: A coup attempt fails; the army leadership is replaced.
enden.putsch.gescheitert.text1: Units under {general} tried to seize the broadcasters and ministries. Loyal troops and people on the streets stopped the attempt within hours.
enden.putsch.gescheitert.text2: The general staff has been replaced and the officer corps is shaken. The government stands stronger, but the price is high: distrust of the army and calls for harsh measures.
enden.putsch.gescheitert_grund: Removed and arrested after the failed coup
enden.putsch.text: During the night, units under {general} seize the broadcasters, ministries and airports. {name} is detained; the army declares the government deposed. The term ends.
enden.putsch.warnung.abwarten_ausgang: You settle for observation; the risk remains.
enden.putsch.warnung.abwarten_beschr: No cost. The risk stays as it is.
enden.putsch.warnung.einbinden_ausgang: Promotions, better pay and new procurement bind the officers in. Their trust rises; the risk falls for a year.
enden.putsch.warnung.einbinden_beschr: Costs {pk} capital and about 0.4 percent of economic output. Promotions, pay and contracts raise trust; the risk falls for a year.
enden.putsch.warnung.entlassen: Dismiss the Chief of the General Staff
enden.putsch.warnung.entlassen_ausgang: The Chief of the General Staff is dismissed; an acting successor leads the forces. The officer corps is angry, but the immediate danger is averted.
enden.putsch.warnung.entlassen_beschr: Costs {pk} capital. The danger he poses is removed; the officer corps resents it (trust in the officer corps falls).
enden.putsch.warnung.text1: The intelligence service and your staff report: officers are coordinating. The risk of an overthrow stands at {risiko} out of 100.
enden.putsch.warnung.text2: If you do nothing now, you risk the Chief of the General Staff choosing the moment.
enden.putsch.warnung.warum: A coup threatens where the officer corps no longer trusts the leadership, the Chief of the General Staff is ambitious and not very loyal, and the street does not stand behind the government. That holds for every political direction.
enden.risiko.ehrgeiz: Ambition of the Chief of the General Staff
enden.risiko.loyalitaet: Loyalty of the Chief of the General Staff
enden.risiko.schutz: Protection after a purge or after integrating the officers
enden.ruecktritt.durchhalten_ausgang: You hold on. The bloc grumbles and the country watches.
enden.ruecktritt.durchhalten_beschr: Costs {pk} capital; the partners lose some trust. The office stays.
enden.ruecktritt.erklaeren_beschr: The office ends at once with a balance sheet.
enden.ruecktritt.forderung.text1: With approval at {zustimmung} percent, partners and press demand the president’s resignation.
enden.ruecktritt.forderung.text2: The bloc wavers. Whoever leaves now leaves with dignity; whoever stays risks the pressure coming from the street.
enden.ruecktritt.forderung.warum: A president without backing among the people and in his own bloc cannot govern. The office gives him the choice of when to go.
enden.ruecktritt.text: {name} announces resignation. The office falls vacant; a new election follows within 45 days, until then the vice president deputises.
enden.wk.auftritt.allein.gut: {name} appears alone and convinces: their own themes, their own tone, a candidate people remember.
enden.wk.auftritt.allein.schlecht: {name} appears alone but the spark does not catch: pale, too little known, too much shadow.
enden.wk.auftritt.ergebnis: {text} Effect on election day: {punkte, number, 2} percentage points.
enden.wk.auftritt.gemeinsam.gut: On stage together: the president’s popularity rubs off on {name}, and the halls cheer.
enden.wk.auftritt.gemeinsam.schlecht: On stage together: the president is unpopular and {name} stands in the shadow. The pictures do harm.
enden.wk.auftritt.kein_nachfolger: There is no successor to campaign for.
enden.wk.auftritt.kein_wahlkampf: There is no campaign under way.
enden.wk.auftritt.max: More than {n} appearances of this kind no longer have any effect.
enden.wk.auftritt.zu_wenig: The appearance costs {kosten} action points; the weekly budget stands at {ap}.
enden.wk.beginn.text1: Eight weeks to the election on {datum}. You no longer stand: {name} runs for your bloc, and you campaign at their side with trips, promises and joint appearances.
enden.wk.beginn.text2: Every week {ap} action points are available. Your effect carries over to the successor only in part; a joint appearance can help or hurt, depending on what the country thinks of you.
enden.wk.beginn.titel: The campaign for the successor begins
enden.wk.ui.auftritte_text: Together with the president, their popularity rubs off, for better or worse. Alone, the successor must convince on their own. Each kind wears out with every appearance.
enden.wk.ui.bilanz: Effect of the appearances so far: {punkte, number, 2} points
enden.wk.ui.duell_text: On {datum}, {name} faces {gegner} ({partei}). Preparation costs {ap} AP; going in unprepared is the risk.
enden.wk.ui.kosten: {ap} AP · {uebrig} of {max} left · expected {punkte, number, 2} points
enden.wk.ui.untertitel: You no longer stand. You campaign for your bloc’s candidate: {rolle} {name}, appeal {staerke} out of 100.
enden.wk.ui.versprechen_text: The successor makes the promises: each brings applause now, but no pledge to you, because your term ends with the election. Credibility stands at {glaub}; how far people believe them depends on it (effect ×{faktor, number, 2}).
vermaechtnis.amtszeit.zeile: Term {nr}: {von, date} to {bis, date}; approval from {start, number, 1} to {ende, number, 1} percent
vermaechtnis.ende.amtszeitende: End: the last term has run out
vermaechtnis.epilog.abwahl: The opposition takes over the office. What remains is what people feel of it: the balance sheet shows what was achieved and what was not. A new game begins with a new country and a new question.
vermaechtnis.epilog.amtsenthebung: The office ends through a verdict. The country remains divided over whether it was justice or revenge.
vermaechtnis.epilog.amtszeitende: The constitution allows no further term. The country looks back: it will remember the time as it lived it.
vermaechtnis.epilog.amtszeitende_niederl: The constitution has ended the office, and the bloc has lost the succession. What you built now lies in the hands of those you fought.
vermaechtnis.epilog.amtszeitende_sieg: Power is handed over in an orderly way: the bloc’s successor has won the election. That is the rarest form of legacy, one that keeps working.
vermaechtnis.epilog.laufend: The career is still under way. This look back shows the state up to today.
vermaechtnis.epilog.putsch: The military has pushed the constitution aside. What follows is no longer decided by elections but by those who now hold power.
vermaechtnis.epilog.ruecktritt: The resignation opens the way to a new election within 45 days. History will ask whether it came in time.
vermaechtnis.epilog.sturz: The street decided before the voters could. Whoever ends like this is judged less by their goals than by how they handled their support.
vermaechtnis.epilog.tod: The country mourns, and the constitution provides for a new election within 45 days. The balance sheet draws the line under a term that did not run its course.
vermaechtnis.erhalten: This save is kept under “Furthest save” on the title screen.

vermaechtnis.kap.zustimmung_text: Month by month: above the 50 percent line lies victory, below the 25 percent line the fall threatens.
vermaechtnis.kicker: A look back at the career of {name}
vermaechtnis.kriege.keine: Turkey fought no war in this period.

vermaechtnis.verfassung.text: {n, plural, one {One article} other {# articles}} changed: {artikel, list}.

vermaechtnis.wendepunkte.keine: Nothing that would have demanded an answer.
vermaechtnis.zeitraum: From {von, date} to {bis, date}: {jahre, number, 1} years in office
vermaechtnis.zusagen.text: {gehalten} kept, {gebrochen} broken, {offen} open; credibility {glaub} out of 100.
